limits: Printed coordinate order is a declared source-relative display, not absolute or cross-year chronology.
Year, timezone and missing dates are never filled in.
Adjacent displayed groups are not complete directly-follows when unplaced events could intervene.
An order view references object views; it does not flatten their events into another sequence.
Relationships reflect observations at the accepted checkpoint, not ownership inferred before the relating occurrence.
Source trust is the adopter's experiment assumption, not a new Core truth check.
